parameters.label: Grid X
parameters.help: Number of bases along the X axis.

parameters.label: Grid Y
parameters.help: Number of bases along the Y axis.

parameters.label: Grid height
parameters.help: Height in Gridfinity units when height mode is 0.

parameters.label: Half grid
parameters.help: Use half-grid bases; this also limits holes to corners.

parameters.label: Height mode
parameters.help: Select how gridz is interpreted.

parameters.label: Internal height override
parameters.help: Override the solid fill height; zero uses the calculated height.

parameters.label: Snap height to 7 mm
parameters.help: Round the calculated height up to a 7 mm increment.

parameters.label: Stacking lip
parameters.help: Include the stacking lip.

parameters.label: Divisions X
parameters.help: Number of X divisions; zero makes a solid bin.

parameters.label: Divisions Y
parameters.help: Number of Y divisions; zero makes a solid bin.

parameters.label: Compartment depth
parameters.help: Compartment depth; zero uses the full available depth.

parameters.label: Cylindrical compartments
parameters.help: Use cylindrical cutouts instead of rectangular compartments.

parameters.label: Cylinder diameter
parameters.help: Diameter of cylindrical cutouts.

parameters.label: Cylinder top chamfer
parameters.help: Chamfer around cylindrical cutout rims.

parameters.label: Tab style
parameters.help: Style of label tabs.

parameters.label: Tab placement
parameters.help: Which divisions receive tabs.

parameters.label: Scoop amount
parameters.help: Zero disables the scoop; one is the standard scoop.

parameters.label: Holes only at corners
parameters.help: Only cut mounting holes at the outer corners.

parameters.label: Refined holes
parameters.help: Use Gridfinity refined holes.

parameters.label: Magnet holes
parameters.help: Cut holes for 6 mm x 2 mm magnets.

parameters.label: M3 screw holes
parameters.help: Cut holes for M3 screws.

parameters.label: Crush ribs
parameters.help: Add ribs to retain magnets.

parameters.label: Chamfer holes
parameters.help: Chamfer magnet and screw holes.

parameters.label: Supportless hole tops
parameters.help: Add printable bridges to hole tops.

parameters.label: Thumbscrew holes
parameters.help: Add Gridfinity refined thumbscrew holes.

parameters.label: Grid X
parameters.help: Number of bases along X; zero allows fit-to-drawer sizing.

parameters.label: Grid Y
parameters.help: Number of bases along Y; zero allows fit-to-drawer sizing.

parameters.label: Screw diameter
parameters.help: Screw clearance diameter.

parameters.label: Screw head diameter
parameters.help: Screw head diameter.

parameters.label: Screw spacing
parameters.help: Extra spacing between screw holes.

parameters.label: Screws per grid block
parameters.help: Number of screws per seam.

parameters.label: Minimum X
parameters.help: Minimum plate length; zero uses the grid size.

parameters.label: Minimum Y
parameters.help: Minimum plate width; zero uses the grid size.

parameters.label: Fit X
parameters.help: Align extra X space left, centered, or right.

parameters.label: Fit Y
parameters.help: Align extra Y space bottom, centered, or top.

parameters.label: Baseplate style
parameters.help: Select the plate construction style.

parameters.label: Mount hole style
parameters.help: Select the screw-hole head shape.

parameters.label: Magnet holes
parameters.help: Cut holes for 6 mm x 2 mm magnets.

parameters.label: Crush ribs
parameters.help: Add ribs to retain magnets.

parameters.label: Chamfer holes
parameters.help: Chamfer magnet holes.
